description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate asynchronous messaging from RabbitMQ (AMQP) to Azure Service Bus
tasks.reason: The application uses RabbitMQ for async image processing jobs between the web and worker modules. Migrating to Azure Service Bus removes the dependency on a self-hosted RabbitMQ broker and provides a fully managed, scalable messaging service with Managed Identity support.
tasks.requirements: Migrate all RabbitMQ AMQP messaging in both the web module (publisher via RabbitConfig, BackupMessageProcessor) and the worker module (consumer via RabbitConfig, AbstractFileProcessingService with retry logic and manual acknowledgment) to Azure Service Bus. Preserve the existing retry behavior (max 3 attempts, 60-second backoff). Use Managed Identity for authentication. Remove RabbitMQ host, port, username, and password configuration properties.
tasks.taskSummary: Migrated all RabbitMQ AMQP messaging to Azure Service Bus in both web and worker modules. Replaced spring-boot-starter-amqp with spring-cloud-azure-starter and spring-messaging-azure-servicebus. Updated configuration to use Managed Identity. Replaced RabbitConfig with ServiceBusConfig, RabbitTemplate with ServiceBusTemplate, and @RabbitListener with @ServiceBusListener. Removed all RabbitMQ Docker commands from start/stop scripts. Build passes and all tests pass with no AMQP/RabbitMQ references remaining.
